desc: Whole deck is revealed; any brought card can be played on any action
Waves: 2 actions per side (3 in wave 1), alternating single actions, initiative alternates by wave
Pass ends a side's wave; first to pass gains passFirstEmbers
Summon places a card in an empty own cell for free and fires Kindle
Cast pays the spell cost (with discounts) and resolves immediately with chosen targets
Moving is free up to Swift N steps per wave, then costs extraStepCost; Rooted never moves
Battle ends after wavesPerBattle; higher face damage wins; ties and HP loss per SPEC §9
Warden at 0 HP loses; simultaneous zero resolves by flag; empty board is not a loss
State JSON round-trips and applyAction never mutates its input
renderToText prints an ASCII board with both grids, HP, embers and wave
Random-bot fuzz: 1000 battles with zero ERROR lines
Golden replays (seed + actions + state hash) pass
Clash resolves Front, Mid, Back beats; damage within a beat is simultaneous, deaths after
Strike: front-most enemy in lane, from Front or Mid with empty cell Ahead; face damage on empty lane
Shoot: front-most enemy in lane from any row; face damage on empty lane
Pierce: every enemy in lane from any row, ignores Taunt
Cleave: like Strike plus enemies Beside the target
Lob: back-most enemy in lane over blockers, never from Front, nothing on empty lane
Taunt redirects Strike, Shoot and Cleave in its lane; wide Taunt covers neighbouring lanes
Wave End order: Burn, Poison, Wave End triggers, Shields expire, win check
Deterministic ordering: initiative side, lane A-D, Front-Back; trigger queue capped at 200 with ERROR TRIGGER_LOOP
Clash preview computes the projected attacks and damage for the current board without mutating it
Shield absorbs before health and expires at Wave End unless kept
Burn ticks at Wave End, spreads floor(N/2) to orthogonal allies, then decays by 1
Poison ticks at Wave End ignoring Shield, then decays by 1 unless decay is stopped
Stun skips the unit's next attack
Swift, Rooted, Persist, Pull and push behave per SPEC §7
Kindle, Last Gasp, Wave Start and Wave End triggers fire at the right time
Auras are recomputed from the board, never stored
Tokens: Wisp 1/1 Strike, Bat, Rubble and Bone Wall 0/N Rooted with no traits
Trait counts count different cards on the grid; copies and Flames count once
Tiers stack and are recomputed live whenever a unit enters or leaves
Kinship: +1/+1 per orthogonal neighbour sharing a trait, max +2/+2
All 17 traits' tier effects are implemented
Positional class riders: Guardian shields behind, Marksman back-row Power, Brawler pairs, Chanter diagonal auras
Sigils add one extra trait to a card for the run, within the data's limits
